zoe-privacy: Received DSAR erase for user bob+demo@example.com. There's a legal hold LH-2026 for only meeting transcripts. Need to erase embeddings, analytics logs, and staging snapshots. Can we outline a safe flow?

mike-sre: Which keystore and snapshots?

zoe-privacy: Keystore ks-prod-us-03, snapshots snap-us-20260301 and snap-us-20260410. Legal hold only covers transcript-* objects.

anu-engr: We'll need a scoped ephemeral role for privacy-worker with actions [vectordb:Delete, s3:DeleteObject, kms:Decrypt] and TTL=4h. Avoid broad perms.

tess-security: Agreed. Require that delete calls include trace_id and that the audit-forwarder writes a signed receipt (ND key=value) to compliance-bucket/completed-dsars/4150001234/. Fields: actor, svc, action, resource, key_id, trace_id, timestamp, hash, signature.

legal-bot: Legal: we will not release snapshots under LH-2026 until we validate receipts for non-held objects. We'll provide conditional release once sample receipts verified.

mike-sre: Plan: 1) create role ROLE-ERASE-415000 with tenant constraint bob-tenant and 4h expiry, 2) dry-run (emit receipts, no delete), 3) real run in maintenance window, 4) eviction + index prune + verification scan, 5) attach receipts and request conditional release.

anu-engr: Note TICKET-9510: async delete retry bug can requeue deleted ids if KV rewrap fails. We'll run the eviction job and apply the retry-guard patch in canary before mass run.

tess-security: Also ensure keystore metadata is uploaded encrypted and wiped from ephemeral hosts. Keystore integrity check post-run mandatory; if old ciphertext remains decryptable for deleted objects, escalate immediately.

zoe-privacy: I'll request the role and schedule dry-run. Thanks everyone.
